top_band: full 48-row ground surface of staggered stone/metal floor tiles
evidence: This is a terrain/ground tile block (staggered paving stones) seen from above as a horizontal surface, which is appropriate for the terrain kind.

style.evidence: Each stone slab has large 5x5+ areas of completely uniform flat tan colour (#9e9284) with only a tiny 1-3px corner highlight and one small dark blotch, repeating identically across every 16x16 tile. Compared to the Beodeul cobblestone paving reference, which has rich per-stone shading and varied surface detail, this has large flat fills and much lower information density.
